name: corrode metal
desc:
Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.
If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} is destroyed after dealing damage. The [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal in 1 round.
The [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} corrodes metal.
